OBS Donut Ride

Oklahoma City, OK · Will Rogers Park

No-dropBeginner friendly

OBS Donut Ride is a road and social group ride in Oklahoma City, OK. It meets every Saturday, 9:04 am, starting at Will Rogers Park Tennis Center, east end of parking lot. Expect about 12 miles, entry level, set by the slowest rider.

About the OBS Donut Ride group ride

About 12 miles round trip to a donut shop and back. The pace is set by the slowest rider, and nobody gets dropped. Runs every Saturday of the year, weather permitting. A good first group ride in OKC.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
